plan.original_corpus: All twelve original sources, inputs and holdouts unchanged; four additional clear-loop compute cases preregistered before timing
plan.comparison: BBC v3 baseline versus v4 movement-packed BBC versus pinned Brainfry default native AOT. Actual native BF components and canonical importers; unchanged generic XAX bootstrap verification/binding/lowering.
plan.pipeline: Complete original source through complete standalone executable, fresh required compiler processes including generic Python bootstrap host for BBC. Baseline and optimized BBC share mapped zero-initialized importer workspace and release it before verification/lowering; this is an explicit external-buffer configuration, not a canonical importer change. Compiler construction, SDK installation and deployment excluded equally.
plan.runtime: Complete standalone process, binary stdin/stdout, exact output and successful exit required. Windows perf_counter_ns around detached CreateProcess/communicate/wait, input-file opening outside; Android native CLOCK_MONOTONIC around fork/exec/output consumption/wait4, pipe/input preparation and ADB outside. No overhead subtraction.
plan.trials: Three independent run clusters, four timed observations per arm/case/target/run, twelve total; all six arm permutations repeated twice, fixed-seed shuffled; runtime2warmups and build1warmup per arm/case/run; serial primary jobs.
plan.memory: Windows kernel lifetime peak working set queried after exit on retained process handle; each compiler worker has no child tools during measured compilation, so its required process tree has one process. Android child ru_maxrss measured by wait4 in KiB, not PSS. Shared pages and fork/loader floors limit attribution. No sampled resident sum or declared-view-as-RAM inference.
plan.limits: No new real applications, no 20-workload/ten-eligible-per-comparator unrestricted sweep. CPU frequency, thermals, affinity and desktop/device background work uncontrolled. Each scored invocation must pass exact oracle/status. All samples retained; unavailable metrics remain unavailable.

configuration.measurement_host_policy: Serial primary jobs; normal uncontrolled desktop/device background work. Source/document maintenance performed during trials; no concurrent benchmark jobs, deployment excluded. No affinity/frequency/thermal controls or overhead subtraction.

statistics.estimator: Per-case ratios use arm medians; fixed-corpus aggregates are geometric means of those ratios. Intervals instead estimate paired-log geometric means and are explicitly labeled.
statistics.intervals: 5000 fixed-seed hierarchical bootstrap draws: resample three run clusters, then four paired observations within each chosen cluster. 95% percentile intervals are exploratory, unadjusted; three clusters sharply limit inference.
statistics.multiplicity: Exact two-sided sign flips of three independent run means; Holm adjustment across all 64 per-case comparisons for each timing metric (16 cases, two targets, two reference arms). With three clusters the smallest two-sided p is 0.25; no confirmatory superiority is claimed.
statistics.memory: Observed OS lifetime high-water counters; no statistical memory victory asserted. Windows peak pagefile remains raw separate data, not job peak commit. Android fork/loader/shared-page floor limits small-program attribution.
statistics.categories: real-decision is the frozen source workload category, not execution inside a real application. No real-app or energy result.
